info.title: Blaaiz Platform API - Create Crypto Payout
info.description: Send crypto from a business crypto wallet to an external on-chain address.

customer_id.description: The ID of a VERIFIED customer that belongs to your business.

amount.description: The crypto amount. The minimum is 0.00000001. Send a string with up to 18 decimal places.

token.description: The token symbol for the selected network.

rate.description: The rate used for this payout.

amount.description: The source amount as a decimal string.

fee.description: The total fee as a decimal string.

net_amount.description: The source amount after fees as a decimal string.

destination_amount.description: The destination amount as a decimal string.

post.description: Send crypto to an external address. The source wallet must belong to your business. The customer must belong to your business and have a VERIFIED status. The address must not be a Blaaiz wallet address. The request needs approved KYB and an `Idempotency-Key`. Required scope: `crypto-payout:create`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A unique key for this payout request.

400.description: The customer does not belong to your business or cannot be used for a payout.

409.description: A request with the same idempotency key is active.

422.description: The idempotency key is missing, the amount is not a string, or the key was used with different request data.
